checks.name: remote API access boundary and single-user loopback architecture
checks.evidence: [packages/server/src/index.ts:5-8] enforces loopback by default and requires SURFACETRACE_API_TOKEN for non-loopback HOST; [packages/server/src/app.ts:194-196,317] validates a >=32-character token and rejects non-loopback API access without a bearer token; [README.md:55] and [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:122-124] document the explicit single-user local boundary.

checks.name: evidence record ID tamper detection
checks.evidence: [packages/core/src/evidence/ledger.ts:19-23,41-53] derives id from contentHash and verifies r.id === r.contentHash.slice(0, 24) during chain validation; [packages/core/test/core.test.ts:272-282] includes a regression test that mutates id and expects verify() to fail.

checks.name: canonical three-agent roster integrity
checks.evidence: [scripts/security-team.mjs:21-93] defines the canonical three-agent team list, embeds it into the run manifest scope, and freezes if manifest.agents differs from the expected roster; [scripts/test/security-team.test.mjs:31-39] covers the reduced-roster freeze case.

checks.name: receipt contract validation
checks.evidence: [security-teams/receipt-schema.json] requires agent, run_id, scope_sha256, status, findings, checks, and limitations with typed fields; [scripts/security-team.mjs:22-40] enforces required receipt structure, valid status values, nonempty checks, and nonempty evidence strings before gate evaluation.

checks.name: blocking of failed or untested checks
checks.evidence: [scripts/security-team.mjs:80-89] returns BLOCK when any receipt has status other than PASS, any check result is not PASS, or any actionable finding is present; [scripts/test/security-team.test.mjs:41-49] asserts BLOCK when a PASS receipt contains a failed check.

limitations: Passive source-and-test review only; no network traffic was sent.

`node --test` could not complete a full workspace run in this environment because the Windows temp-directory mkdtemp path used by the test harness returned EPERM; verification therefore relies on the current source plus targeted test files and the partially executed test run.
